name: uon-video-finisher
description: Add approved UoN branding and consistent audio levels to an educational video, entirely in the browser.

scripts.build:xerte: npm run check:placeholders && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode xerte
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('test context: an unusually long DSP timeout may be machine contention; rerun on a settled machine before changing the timeout or assertion')" && vitest run
scripts.check: npm run check:placeholders && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:build && npm run docs:lint && npm run docs:links && npm run check:memory && node tools/check.mjs
